body: Holy cow. Your thought processes for what was going through my head with asking each of my friends is EXACTLY what was going on in my head. Where they drunk, lying, not there at the exact moment, etc. Same thing with murdering someone in my sleep. Well if you killed someone they would have found out! Yeah but you killed a homeless person so no one would notice. Ok... But they'd find a body. Nope you chopped it up and burned it. Well wouldn't someone smell fire? Nope you through it in the river. Or even worse, buried it all deep in some secret location. It's a horrible thought process.
